Game Overview

At its heart, Enemy Attack is a monster game about battle relentless swarms of bats in this intense, fast-paced shooter. Sharpen your reflexes, aim precisely, and strategize your defense as levels grow harder. With every wave, survival becomes a thrilling test of skill, offering you a satisfying challenge that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
